mapper.select: /* file : MakeMetaSimulationSchedulerMapper.xml, id : getTargetModel */ SELECT A.* , C.FILE_SEQ , C.FILE_NM , C.STRG_FILE_NM , C.FILE_PATH , D.INDEX_TRGT_COL FROM TB_META_USER_ITEM A JOIN TB_META_MODEL_FILES C ON A.MODEL_SEQ = C.MODEL_SEQ AND C.REF_TP = 'DATA' JOIN TB_META_MODEL D ON C.MODEL_SEQ = D.MODEL_SEQ AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} LIMIT 1
